overview.text: Indira Gandhi Institute of Technology (IGIT), Sarang, Dhenkanal, Odisha invites proposals for a cloud based, SaaS mode ERP system covering academic, finance, HR, hostel and related modules, plus website re-design. The selected bidder must develop and implement it, then maintain it under a three year contract. The notice is dated 15.04.2021.

summary.issuing_organization: Indira Gandhi Institute of Technology (IGIT), Sarang; Sarang, Dhenkanal-759146, Odisha; notice dated 15.04.2021, notice number left blank; bids addressed to The Director

scope.text: Install and commission a cloud based SAAS mode ERP; the bidder must develop, test, install and turn over the software to IGIT Sarang, with prices all-inclusive.
Admission management, academic management (courses, syllabus), attendance and time table management, and examination management modules (pre and post exams, results, mark sheets).
Fees management module: configurable fee structures, collection, dues alerts, late fines, scholarships, waivers and refunds.
Administration and establishment (HR) module, and payroll system covering leave, salary, arrears, pension contribution and appraisals.
Finance and accounts, budgeting, and purchase and inventory management modules (vouchers, general ledger, procure to pay, stock).
Hostel management, student feedback management, and faculty/employee and student self-service portals.
Website re-design: link all ERP data to the institute website and upgrade it from time to time.
Maintain the cloud based ERP under a contract for three years, priced as annual subscription charges.

key_requirements.text: Bidder must be a product bidder and a one-stop solution for development, implementation and maintenance of the product.
Application must be ready to use, and the bidder must demonstrate module functionality with valid data.
Application must be completely web-based, needing no client software other than a web browser.
Must work with a public domain RDBMS; application should be free of proprietary software and use only open standard components.
Must develop and implement the ERP successfully within 500 working days from receiving the work order.
Backup and restore must be provided, including complete offline and online backup and incremental backup.

Security: super administrator and module administrators, user creation with menu-level privileges, user-name logging of all transactions, and IP address based protection (transactions only from specific IP addresses).
Accounting software must conform to Central Auditor General rules and standards and the IT Act where applicable, and be acceptable to audit.
Bidder must migrate legacy data using repeatable scripts, run old and new software in parallel for a period, and keep legacy data portable without extra cost.
Bidder must keep at least one software engineer at IGIT for 3 years (B.Tech/B.E. in CSE/IT with 2 to 5 years of ERP maintenance experience) after implementation.

eligibility.text: Bidder must be of national standing and repute, with experience implementing similar systems in Indian state or central universities of higher education for around 5000 user capacity.
Bidder must provide copies of PAN no, GST certificate, Certification of Incorporation and last 3 years income tax return statement.
Bidder must be a company registered with the Registrar of Companies and registered with GST, with supporting documents.
Technical bid checklist requires a list of at least 5 qualified service engineers with more than 5 years of experience, with qualification and experience certificates.
Technical bid checklist requires a list of clients where the company currently maintains systems (at least one location in Odisha), with work orders or evidence from Govt. departments or PSUs.
Bidder must provide reference accounts where similar work in scope and design was completed, with contact details.
ISO certification for software development, security certificates such as cert-in and CMMi, and ISO 9001 and ISO 27001 are preferred, not mandatory.
Not specified in the document: minimum turnover, JV/consortium rules, blacklisting declaration.

important_dates.text: RFP document available on the IGIT Sarang website from 19.04.2021.
Written clarification requests must be made within one week of issue of the RFP.
Last date and time for submission of the completed RFP: 12.05.2021 up to 10 AM.
Opening of RFP (Technical Bid Part-I): 18.05.2021 at 10 AM.
Technical presentation on approach and methodology: To be notified later.
Opening of Financial Bid (Part-II): To be notified later.
RFP response must stay valid for 90 (ninety) days after the RFP response opening date.

commercial_requirements.text: Cost of tender documents: Rs 1,000/- (Rupees one thousand only).
EMD of Rs 60,000/- (INR) as a Demand Draft in favour of Principal, IGIT Sarang, payable at IGIT Sarang, must accompany the proposal; proposals without it will be rejected.
No bank guarantee is accepted in lieu of EMD, and no interest is paid on EMD.

Security Deposit of 10 (ten) per cent of total contract cost as an unconditional, irrevocable bank guarantee from a scheduled commercial bank in India, for the contract period with 90 days claim period, submitted after contract award.
Implementation payment in five phases: 15% each for Phases 1 to 4 (Academics, Examination, Administration, Accounts and other modules) and 40% after one year of stable system and handover.
Annual subscription for a three year contract is paid quarterly, based on actual number of users, after all modules are implemented.
Prices must be all-inclusive and fixed during the contract period; quoted prices stay in effect for at least One year from the last date of bid submission.
Liquidated damages / penalties: Not specified in the document.

project_duration.text: Maintenance contract for three years for the cloud based ERP system.
ERP must be developed and implemented within 500 working days from receiving the work order.
Acceptance testing and end-user training to be completed within 15 days of acceptance of work order, without extra cost.
Defects found by IGIT during system testing must be removed within maximum two days.
Bidder should establish a technical control centre at IGIT, Sarang for a period of three years or more from the date of completion.
One year of free up-gradation/maintenance service after deployment of the ERP package.
At least one software engineer must be stationed at IGIT for 3 years after implementation.

important_conditions.text: Evaluation: Technical bids are scrutinized per standard pre-eligibility norms; selected bidders are called for a 10-15 minute presentation.
Evaluation: Applicants must present a pilot demo version of a module, covering understanding and compliance, design templates, proof of concept, experience and ease of management.
Evaluation: Institute decides on pre-eligibility criteria and demo performance, then opens financial bids of selected bidders; no scoring weights, QCBS/L1 rule or minimum score is stated.
Submission: Printed, signed and bound copy in a sealed super-scribed cover, by registered/speed post only, to The Director, IGIT Sarang, by 12.05.2021, 10 AM.

Submission: Envelope 1 holds the Technical Proposal (specifications, compliance, implementation plan, warranty and support plan, registration documents, signed terms); the Financial Bid is a sealed cover inside the RFP cover.
Submission: Financial bid must follow the Annexure-1 proforma (Tables A, B, C); write 0 (zero) where no cost applies to an item.
Submission: Conditional or incomplete bids, and late applications, will be rejected; late ones are returned unopened.
Submission: Technical bid must include the checklist: organization details, registration documents, ISO certificates, tender fee and EMD, engineer list and client list in the given proformas.
Risk: Conflict on durations - response validity is 90 days after opening (page 14), but prices must stay in effect for at least One year from last date of submission (page 17).
Risk: Training and acceptance testing within 15 days of acceptance of work order, and defect fixes within two days, are tight and the 15 day start point is unclear.
Risk: Director of the institute is sole arbitrator and his decision is final; disputes going to court are decided at Kamakhyanagar/Dhenkanal.
Risk: Award or cancellation is at IGIT Sarang's sole discretion, and it may reject any or all offers without reason; invitation of tenders is not a commitment.
Risk: 40% of implementation payment is held until one year after stable operation, and subscription is paid on actual number of users, which may vary from year to year.
Risk: Evaluation weights are absent, presentation and financial bid opening dates are To be notified later, and the schedule may change.
